title: BurdenAudit
description: Standalone burden audit of a rule: every point where the text demands an input from a regulated party, with categorized effort. Runs directly on statute text (no compilation needed) or as an annotation pass over a compilation's input_schema. Extraction and effort estimation are separate, separately validated steps: extraction is validated by recall against hand annotation and implementer checklists; effort estimates are validated against external data (PRA/ICR burden hours, fee schedules, permit timestamps) and are PRIORS until then.

demands.description: One entry per distinct input the rule's process requires someone to produce.

provenance_class.description: a=known offhand/self-attestation; b=document already in household records; c=requested from an institution; d=artifact applicant creates; e=artifact paid professional creates; f=government act (inspection/appointment).

effort.description: Point estimates overriding the class prior, with an EMPIRICAL flag when a real data source should replace the guess.

basis.description: Why this estimate; name the data source that would validate it.

sensitive.description: Supplying it exposes the party to legal/financial risk.

learning_cost.description: What the party must understand before they can even know this is demanded of them (sludge/learning-cost axis).

conditional_on.description: If the demand only arises on some paths (e.g. only if an inspection finds a violation), state the condition. Path-dependence is what makes expected burden differ from total burden.
